Celebi

Psychic Grass

Johto · Generation 2 · Mythical Pokémon

Celebi is a Psychic/Grass-type Time Travel Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2), and is classed as a Mythical Pokémon. It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 5 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is HP (100), with a base stat total of 600.
